fn getenv (key default)
    val := (getattr (import .libc) 'getenv) key
    if (val == null) default else String (val as rawstring)

fn sql-escape (s)
    buf := StringBuffer
    for c in s
        if (c == 39) buf .. "''"
        elseif (c == 92) buf .. "\\\\"
        elseif (c == 0) buf .. "\\0"
        elseif (c == 10) buf .. "\\n"
        elseif (c == 13) buf .. "\\r"
        elseif (c == 26) buf .. "\\Z"
        elseif (c == 34) buf .. "\\\""
        else buf .. (tostring c)
    buf as String

fn sha1-raw (s)
    ctx := SHA_CTX
    SHA1_Init &ctx
    SHA1_Update &ctx (s as rawstring) (countof s)
    digest := (array i8 20)
    SHA1_Final (digest as rawstring) &ctx
    digest

fn mysql-scramble (pwd scramble)
    p1 := sha1-raw pwd
    p2 := sha1-raw (p1 as String)
    p3 := sha1-raw ((scramble as String) .. (p2 as String))
    out := (array i8 20)
    for i in (range 20)
        out @ i = ((p1 @ i) as i8) ^ ((p3 @ i) as i8)
    out

fn string-trim (s)
    i := 0
    j := (countof s)
    while (i < j) and (((s @ i) == 32) or ((s @ i) == 9) or ((s @ i) == 10) or ((s @ i) == 13))
        i += 1
    while (j > i) and (((s @ (j - 1)) == 32) or ((s @ (j - 1)) == 9) or ((s @ (j - 1)) == 10) or ((s @ (j - 1)) == 13))
        j -= 1
    s slice i j

fn split-string (s delim)
    out := (Array)
    start := 0
    dlen := (countof delim)
    loop (i)
        if (i >= (countof s))
            'append out (s slice start (countof s))
            break out
        if ((i + dlen <= (countof s)) and ((s slice i (i + dlen)) == delim))
            'append out (s slice start i)
            start := i + dlen
            i + dlen
        else
            i + 1

fn sha512-hex (s)
    ctx := SHA512_CTX
    SHA512_Init &ctx
    SHA512_Update &ctx (s as rawstring) (countof s)
    digest := (array i8 64)
    SHA512_Final (digest as rawstring) &ctx
    buf := StringBuffer
    for i in (range 64)
        val := (digest @ i) as u8
        hi := (val >> 4) & 0xF
        lo := val & 0xF
        buf .. (if (hi < 10) (tostring (hi + 48)) (tostring (hi - 10 + 65)))
        buf .. (if (lo < 10) (tostring (lo + 48)) (tostring (lo - 10 + 65)))
    buf as String

fn current-time-seconds ()
    tv := (array i64 2)
    gettimeofday tv null
    ((tv @ 0) as f64) + (((tv @ 1) as f64) / 1000000.0)

fn build-json (val)
    switch (typeof val)
    case String
        s := val as String
        buf := StringBuffer
        buf .. "\""
        for c in s
            if (c == 34) buf .. "\\\""
            elseif (c == 92) buf .. "\\\\"
            elseif (c == 10) buf .. "\\n"
            elseif (c == 13) buf .. "\\r"
            elseif (c == 9) buf .. "\\t"
            else buf .. (tostring c)
        buf .. "\""
        buf as String
    case boolean
        if (val as boolean) "true" else "false"
    case integer
        tostring (val as integer)
    case real
        tostring (val as real)
    case null
        "null"
    case table
        buf := "{"
        first := true
        for k v in (val as table)
            if (not first) buf ..= ","
            first := false
            buf ..= build-json k
            buf ..= ":"
            buf ..= build-json v
        buf .. "}"
    case array
        buf := "["
        first := true
        for v in (val as array)
            if (not first) buf ..= ","
            first := false
            buf ..= build-json v
        buf .. "]"
    default
        "null"

fn json-parse-skip-ws (s idx)
    while (idx < (countof s))
        c := s @ idx
        if (c != 32) and (c != 9) and (c != 10) and (c != 13)
            break
        idx + 1

fn json-parse-string (s idx)
    if ((s @ idx) != 34) return ('null null) idx
    idx += 1
    buf := StringBuffer
    loop (idx)
        if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('string (buf as String)) idx
        c := s @ idx
        if (c == 34) break ('string (buf as String)) (idx + 1)
        if (c == 92)
            if (idx + 1 < (countof s))
                n := s @ (idx + 1)
                if (n == 110) buf ..= "\n"
                elseif (n == 114) buf ..= "\r"
                elseif (n == 116) buf ..= "\t"
                elseif (n == 34) buf ..= '"'
                elseif (n == 92) buf ..= "\\"
                else buf ..= (tostring n)
                idx := idx + 2
            else idx + 1
        else
            buf ..= (tostring c)
            idx + 1

fn json-parse-number (s idx)
    start := idx
    is-float := false
    loop (idx)
        if (idx >= (countof s)) break idx
        c := s @ idx
        if (c >= 48) and (c <= 57) idx + 1
        elseif (c == 45) idx + 1
        elseif (c == 46) is-float := true; idx + 1
        elseif (c == 69) or (c == 101) is-float := true; idx + 1
        else break idx
    str := s slice start idx
    if is-float ('real (atof (str as rawstring))) idx
    else ('integer (atoi (str as rawstring))) idx

fn json-parse-value (s idx)
    idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
    if (idx >= (countof s)) return ('null null) idx
    c := s @ idx
    if (c == 34) json-parse-string s idx
    elseif (c == 123)
        idx += 1
        obj := (table)
        loop (idx)
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('table obj) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 125) break ('table obj) (idx + 1)
            key kidx := json-parse-value s idx
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s kidx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('table obj) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 58) idx := json-parse-skip-ws s (idx + 1)
            val vidx := json-parse-value s idx
            idx := vidx
            if ((typeof key) == String) obj @ (key as String) = val
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx < (countof s)) and ((s @ idx) == 44) idx := idx + 1
    elseif (c == 91)
        idx += 1
        arr := (Array)
        loop (idx)
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx >= (countof s)) break ('array arr) idx
            if ((s @ idx) == 93) break ('array arr) (idx + 1)
            val vidx := json-parse-value s idx
            idx := vidx
            'append arr val
            idx := json-parse-skip-ws s idx
            if (idx < (countof s)) and ((s @ idx) == 44) idx := idx + 1
    elseif (c == 116) if ((s slice idx (idx + 4)) == "true") ('boolean true) (idx + 4) else ('null null) idx
    elseif (c == 102) if ((s slice idx (idx + 5)) == "false") ('boolean false) (idx + 5) else ('null null) idx
    elseif (c == 110) if ((s slice idx (idx + 4)) == "null") ('null null) (idx + 4) else ('null null) idx
    else json-parse-number s idx

fn parse-json (s)
    val idx := json-parse-value s 0
    val

global redis-pool = (Array i32)
global mysql-pool = (Array i32)
global redis-pool-idx = 0

global last-health-check = 0.0

fn redis-connect-single (host port)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return -1
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host
    if ((connect fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr) as i32) != 0)
        close fd
        return -1
    fd

fn mysql-connect-single (host port user pwd db)
    fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    if (fd < 0) return -1
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons port
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = inet_addr host
    if ((connect fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr) as i32) != 0)
        close fd
        return -1
    
    header := (array i8 4)
    if ((recv fd (header as rawstring) 4 0) != 4)
        close fd
        return -1
    len := (header @ 0) as i32 | ((header @ 1) as i32 << 8) | ((header @ 2) as i32 << 16)
    pkt := (array i8 (len + 10))
    pkt @ 0 = (header @ 3)
    if ((recv fd ((pkt as rawstring) + 1) len 0) != len)
        close fd
        return -1
    
    scramble := ""
    if (len > 10)
        s1 := (pkt slice 5 13)
        if (len > 36)
            s2 := (pkt slice 28 40)
            scramble = (s1 as String) .. (s2 as String)
        else scramble = s1 as String
    
    resp-pkt := StringBuffer
    cap := 157403712
    resp-pkt .. (tostring (cap & 0xFF)) .. (tostring ((cap >> 8) & 0xFF)) .. (tostring ((cap >> 16) & 0xFF)) .. (tostring ((cap >> 24) & 0xFF))
    resp-pkt .. "\x00\x00\x00\x01" .. "\x21" .. ((array i8 23) as String) .. user .. "\x00"
    sc := mysql-scramble pwd scramble
    resp-pkt .. (tostring (countof sc)) .. (sc as String) .. db .. "\x00"
    
    final-pkt := (array i8 4)
    rlen := countof resp-pkt
    final-pkt @ 0 = (rlen & 0xFF) as i8
    final-pkt @ 1 = ((rlen >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    final-pkt @ 2 = ((rlen >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    final-pkt @ 3 = 1
    if ((send fd (final-pkt as rawstring) 4 0) != 4)
        close fd
        return -1
    if ((send fd ((resp-pkt as String) as rawstring) rlen 0) != rlen)
        close fd
        return -1
    
    recv fd (array i8 256) 256 0
    fd

fn init-pools (rhost rport shost sport suser spwd sdb)
    for i in (range pool-size)
        rfd := redis-connect-single rhost rport
        'append redis-pool rfd
        
        mfd := mysql-connect-single shost sport suser spwd sdb
        'append mysql-pool mfd

fn health-check-pools (rhost rport shost sport suser spwd sdb)
    now := current-time-seconds
    if ((now - last-health-check) < 300.0) return
    last-health-check = now
    
    for i in (range (countof redis-pool))
        fd := redis-pool @ i
        if (fd < 0)
            redis-pool @ i = redis-connect-single rhost rport
        else
            send fd "*1\r\n$4\r\nPING\r\n" 14 0
            buf := (array i8 16)
            n := recv fd (buf as rawstring) 16 0
            if (n <= 0)
                close fd
                redis-pool @ i = redis-connect-single rhost rport
    
    for i in (range (countof mysql-pool))
        fd := mysql-pool @ i
        if (fd < 0)
            mysql-pool @ i = mysql-connect-single shost sport suser spwd sdb
        else
            q := "\x03SELECT 1"
            h := (array i8 4)
            ql := countof q
            h @ 0 = (ql & 0xFF) as i8
            h @ 1 = ((ql >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
            h @ 2 = ((ql >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
            h @ 3 = 0
            r1 := send fd (h as rawstring) 4 0
            r2 := send fd (q as rawstring) ql 0
            if ((r1 <= 0) or (r2 <= 0))
                close fd
                mysql-pool @ i = mysql-connect-single shost sport suser spwd sdb
            else
                tmp := (array i8 1024)
                recv fd (tmp as rawstring) 1024 0

fn get-redis-conn (rhost rport)
    if ((countof redis-pool) == 0) return -1
    local attempts := 0
    loop ()
        if (attempts >= (countof redis-pool)) break
        idx := redis-pool-idx
        redis-pool-idx = (redis-pool-idx + 1) % (countof redis-pool)
        fd := redis-pool @ idx
        if (fd >= 0)
            return fd
        attempts += 1
    -1

fn get-mysql-conn (shost sport suser spwd sdb)

        if (fd >= 0)
            return fd

fn redis-command (fd cmd args)
    req := "*" .. (tostring (1 + (countof args))) .. "\r\n$" .. (tostring (countof cmd)) .. "\r\n" .. cmd .. "\r\n"
    for arg in args
        s := (arg as String)
        req ..= "$" .. (tostring (countof s)) .. "\r\n" .. s .. "\r\n"
    if (send fd (req as rawstring) (countof req) 0) <= 0) return -1
    0

fn redis-read-response (fd)
    buf := (array i8 1024)
    n := recv fd (buf as rawstring) 1024 0
    if (n <= 0) return ""
    line := String (buf as rawstring n)
    parts := (split-string line "\r\n")
    if ((countof parts) > 0)
        t := parts @ 0
        if ((countof t) > 0)
            ct := t @ 0
            if (ct == 43) return "OK"
            elseif (ct == 45) return "ERR"
            elseif (ct == 36) return if ((countof parts) > 1) (parts @ 1) else ""
            elseif (ct == 58)
                n := (atoi ((t slice 1 (countof t)) as rawstring))
                if (n == 0) return ""
                rb := StringBuffer
                rem := n
                while (rem > 0)
                    sz := if (rem > 1024) 1024 else rem
                    rn := recv fd (buf as rawstring) sz 0
                    if (rn <= 0) break
                    rb .. (String (buf as rawstring rn))
                    rem -= rn
                rn := recv fd (buf as rawstring) 2 0
                rb as String
            else ""
    else ""

fn mysql-query (fd query)
    q := "\x03" .. query
    h := (array i8 4)
    ql := countof q
    h @ 0 = (ql & 0xFF) as i8
    h @ 1 = ((ql >> 8) & 0xFF) as i8
    h @ 2 = ((ql >> 16) & 0xFF) as i8
    h @ 3 = 0
    if ((send fd (h as rawstring) 4 0) != 4) return -1
    if ((send fd (q as rawstring) ql 0) != ql) return -1
    tmp := (array i8 1024)
    recv fd (tmp as rawstring) 1024 0
    0

fn supermemory-upsert (content session-id cid)
    payload := build-json (table
        content = content
        customId = cid
        containerTags = (arrayof String session-id)
    )
    headers := (arrayof String
        "Authorization: Bearer " .. (getenv "SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY" "")

    )
    curl := curl_easy_init
    if (curl == null) return
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_URL ((getenv "SUPERMEMORY_API_URL" "") .. "/documents")
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POST 1
    hlist := curl_slist_append null "Content-Type: application/json"
    hlist := curl_slist_append hlist ("Authorization: Bearer " .. (getenv "SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY" ""))
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER hlist
    rbuf := StringBuffer
    fn wcb (ptr sz nmemb ud)
        (bitcast ud StringBuffer) .. (String (ptr as rawstring) (sz * nmemb))
        (sz * nmemb) as i32
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION wcb
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_WRITEDATA (rbuf as rawstring)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS (payload as rawstring)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_POSTFIELDSIZE (countof payload)
    curl_easy_setopt curl CURLOPT_TIMEOUT 10L
    curl_easy_perform curl
    curl_slist_free_all hlist
    curl_easy_cleanup curl

global curl_multi = curl_multi_init
global curl_clients = (table)
global curl_handle_to_client = (table)

fn curl-socket-callback (easy sock what userp multi)
    action := 0
    if ((what & CURL_POLL_IN) != 0) action |= EPOLLIN
    if ((what & CURL_POLL_OUT) != 0) action |= EPOLLOUT
    
    ev := epoll_event
    ev.events = action as u32
    ev.data.fd = sock
    
    epfd := userp as i32
    if (what != CURL_POLL_NONE)
        if (('key? clients sock)) 
            epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_MOD sock ev
        else
            epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_ADD sock ev
    else
        epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_DEL sock null

fn process-curl-messages ()
    msgs-in-queue := 0
    loop
        msg := curl_multi_info_read curl_multi msgs-in-queue
        if (msg == null) break
        if (msg.msg == CURLMSG_DONE)
            easy := msg.easy_handle
            c-id := curl_handle_to_client @ easy
            client := clients @ c-id
            curl_multi_remove_handle curl_multi easy
            curl_easy_cleanup easy
            'remove curl_handle_to_client easy
            
            if (client.state == "exa-waiting")
                exa-res := client.exa-buffer as String
                exa-data := parse-json exa-res
                results := if ((typeof exa-data) == table) (exa-data @ "results") else (table)
                urls := (Array)
                if ((typeof results) == array)
                    for r in results
                        if ((typeof r) == table) and (('key? r "url"))
                            u := (string-trim (r @ "url" as String))
                            if ((countof u) > 0) 'append urls u
                
                ctx := ""
                if ((countof urls) > 0)
                    ctx := "Web Search Results:\n"
                    for u in urls
                        ctx .. "- " .. u .. "\n"
                
                client.meta @ search-context = ctx
                client.state = "start-stream"
                client.exa-buffer = StringBuffer
            elseif (client.state == "streaming")
                client.state = "finishing"

clients := (table)

fn sse-format (key val)
    "data: " .. (build-json (table key = val)) .. "\n\n"

fn main ()
    server-fd := socket AF_INET SOCK_STREAM 0
    opt := 1
    setsockopt server-fd SOL_SOCKET SO_REUSEADDR (opt as rawstring) (sizeof opt)
    addr := sockaddr_in
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET
    addr.sin_port = htons 5000
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl INADDR_ANY
    bind server-fd (addr as rawstring) (sizeof addr)
    listen server-fd 128
    
    dhost := (getenv "DRAGONFLY_HOST" "127.0.0.1")
    dport := (atoi (getenv "DRAGONFLY_PORT" "6379"))
    shost := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_HOST" "")
    sport := (atoi (getenv "SINGLESTORE_PORT" "3306"))
    suser := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_USER" "root")
    spwd := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_PASSWORD" "")
    sdb := (getenv "SINGLESTORE_DATABASE" "chatbot_db")
    
    init-pools dhost dport shost sport suser spwd sdb
    
    epfd := epoll_create1 0
    ev := epoll_event
    ev.events = EPOLLIN
    ev.data.fd = server-fd
    epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_ADD server-fd ev
    
    curl_multi_setopt curl_multi CURLMOPT_SOCKETFUNCTION curl-socket-callback
    curl_multi_setopt curl_multi CURLMOPT_SOCKETDATA (epfd as rawstring)
    
    loop
        events := (array epoll_event 64)
        nfds := epoll_wait epfd events 64 1000
        if (nfds < 0) break
        
        process-curl-messages
        health-check-pools dhost dport shost sport suser spwd sdb
        
        for i in (range nfds)
            ev := events @ i
            fd := ev.data.fd
            is-curl := false
            if (('key? clients fd) == false)
                if ((ev.events & (EPOLLIN | EPOLLOUT)) != 0)
                    is-curl := true
            
            if is-curl
                running := 0
                curl_multi_socket_action curl_multi fd (ev.events) running
                continue
            
            if (fd == server-fd)
                caddr := sockaddr_in
                len := (sizeof sockaddr_in)
                cfd := accept server-fd (caddr as rawstring) len
                if (cfd >= 0)
                    flags := fcntl cfd F_GETFL 0
                    fcntl cfd F_SETFL (flags | O_NONBLOCK)
                    cev := epoll_event
                    cev.events = EPOLLIN | EPOLLET
                    cev.data.fd = cfd
                    epoll_ctl epfd EPOLL_CTL_ADD cfd cev
                    
                    clients @ cfd = (table
                        fd = cfd
                        read-buf = StringBuffer
                        write-buf = StringBuffer
                        stream-buf = StringBuffer
                        exa-buffer = StringBuffer
                        state = "read-header"
                        session-id = ""
                        message = ""
                        response = ""
                        reasoning = ""
                        start-time = 0.0
                        cached = false
                        deep = false
                        use-memory = false
                        meta = (table)
                        curl-handle = null
                    )
            else
                client := clients @ fd
                if ((ev.events & EPOLLIN) != 0)
                    tmp := (array i8 4096)
                    loop
                        n := recv fd (tmp as rawstring) 4096 0
                        if (n < 0)
                            err := (getattr (import .libc) 'errno)
                            if (err != EAGAIN) break
                        if (n <= 0) break
                        client.read-buf .. (String (tmp as rawstring) n)
                    
                    if (client.state == "read-header")
                        s := (client.read-buf as String)
                        if ((s "in" "\r\n\r\n") != -1)
                            parts := (split-string s "\r\n\r\n")
                            headers := (split-string (parts @ 0) "\r\n")
                            if ((countof headers) > 0)
                                req := (split-string (headers @ 0) " ")
                                if ((countof req) >= 2)
                                    method := req @ 0
                                    path := req @ 1
                                    
                                    if (method == "GET")
                                        if (path == "/")
                                            client.write-buf .. "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n<html><body>AI Service Ready</body></html>"
                                            client.state = "write"
                                        elseif (path == "/health")
                                            h := build-json (table status = "ok" ts = (current-time-seconds))
                                            client.write-buf .. ("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n" .. h)
                                            client.state = "write"
                                        else
                                            client.write-buf .. "HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\n"
                                            client.state = "write"
                                    
                                    elseif (method == "POST") and (path == "/chat")
                                        body := if ((countof parts) > 1) (parts @ 1) else ""
                                        data := parse-json body
                                        if ((typeof data) == table)
                                            client.message := (string-trim (data @ "message" as String))
                                            sid := (string-trim (data @ "session_id" as String))
                                            if ((countof sid) == 0) sid = (sha512-hex "unknown")
                                            client.session-id := sid
                                            client.use-memory := if (('key? data "use_memory")) (data @ "use_memory" as boolean) else false
                                            client.deep := if (('key? data "use_deep")) (data @ "use_deep" as boolean) else false
                                            client.cached := if (('key? data "use_cache")) (data @ "use_cache" as boolean) else true
                                            client.start-time := current-time-seconds
                                            client.state = "check-cache"
                
                if (client.state == "check-cache")
                    msg-hash := (sha512-hex client.message)
                    key := "chat:response:" .. client.session-id .. ":" .. msg-hash
                    rfd := get-redis-conn dhost dport
                    if (rfd >= 0)
                        if ((redis-command rfd "GET" (arrayof String key)) >= 0)
                            val := redis-read-response rfd
                            if ((countof val) > 0)
                                cdata := parse-json val
                                if ((typeof cdata) == table)
                                    client.response := cdata @ "response" as String
                                    client.reasoning := cdata @ "reasoning" as String
                                    client.cached := true
                                    client.state = "prepare-sse"
                                else client.state = "exa-request"
                            else client.state = "exa-request"
                        else client.state = "exa-request"
                    else client.state = "exa-request"
                
                if (client.state == "exa-request")
                    if (client.deep)
                        client.write-buf .. "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/event-stream\r\n\r\n"
                        client.write-buf .. (sse-format "reasoning" "Deep search: analyzing query...")
                        send fd (client.write-buf as rawstring) (countof client.write-buf) 0
                        client.write-buf = StringBuffer
                        
                        payload := build-json (table

### 10. SQL Injection Védelem

A kód implementál egy `sql-escape` függvényt:[16]

```
fn sql-escape (s)
    buf := StringBuffer
    for c in s
        if (c == 39) buf .. "''"
        elseif (c == 92) buf .. "\\\\"
        elseif (c == 0) buf .. "\\0"
```

**Védett karakterek:**
- `'` (single quote) → `''`
- `\` (backslash) → `\\`
- `\0` (null byte) → `\0`
- `\n` (newline) → `\n`
- `\r` (carriage return) → `\r`
- `\Z` (EOF) → `\Z`
- `"` (double quote) → `\"`

Ez védelmet nyújt SQL injection támadások ellen, bár modern gyakorlat szerint prepared statement-ek használata ajánlottabb lenne.

### 11. MySQL Native Protocol Implementáció

A kód közvetlenül implementálja a MySQL wire protocol-t:[17]

**Handshake folyamat:**
1. Server greeting csomag fogadása
2. Capability flags beállítása (157403712)
3. Scramble (salt) kinyerése
4. SHA1-alapú password hashing
5. Authentication response küldése
6. OK packet fogadása

```
sc := mysql-scramble pwd scramble
resp-pkt .. (tostring (countof sc)) .. (sc as String) .. db .. "\x00"
```

**Előnyei:**
- Nincs driver overhead (pl. libmysqlclient)
- Teljes kontroll a protokoll felett
- Alacsonyabb memóriahasználat

### 15. Non-blocking I/O és Buffer Management

A szerver minden socket-et non-blocking módba állít:[7]

```
flags := fcntl cfd F_GETFL 0
fcntl cfd F_SETFL (flags | O_NONBLOCK)
```

**Buffer struktúra minden klienshez:**
- `read-buf`: Bejövő HTTP kérések
- `write-buf`: Kimenő HTTP válaszok
- `stream-buf`: AI streaming buffer
- `exa-buffer`: Web search eredmények

**Chunk-wise sending:**
```
if ((ev.events & EPOLLOUT) != 0) and ((countof client.write-buf) > 0)
    n := send fd (client.write-buf as rawstring) (countof client.write-buf) 0
    if (n > 0)
        client.write-buf = ((client.write-buf as String) slice n)
```

Ez lehetővé teszi a backpressure kezelését - ha a kliens nem tudja elég gyorsan fogadni az adatokat, a szerver buffer-eli azokat és folytatja más kliensek kiszolgálását.

## Teljesítmény Optimalizációk

### 1. Zero-Copy Operációk

A kód minimalizálja a memória másolásokat:
- String slicing reference-ekkel
- Rawstring pointer átadások C funkcióknál
- In-place buffer manipulációk

### 2. Memory Management

Bár a Scopes GC-t használ, a kód optimalizálja az allokációkat:
- StringBuffer-ek újrafelhasználása
- Előre allokált array-ek (pl. `array i8 4096`)
- Short-lived objektumok minimalizálása a hot path-ban

### 3. Computation Offloading

A nehéz számítások (hash-elés, kriptográfia) C library-kre vannak delegálva:
- SHA1/SHA512: OpenSSL `crypto` modul
- Socket operations: POSIX `socket` API
- HTTP requests: `libcurl`

### 4. Round-Robin Load Distribution

A connection pool index-ek ciklikusan forognak:
```
redis-pool-idx = (redis-pool-idx + 1) % (countof redis-pool)
```

Ez egyenletes terhelést biztosít a pool kapcsolatai között.
